analyst.summary: Schneider Electric Infrastructure has a genuinely strong order backlog (up 50% year-on-year) riding India's power grid investment cycle, which gives good multi-quarter revenue visibility. However, the most recent quarter showed a sharp slowdown in new orders and a 66% drop in pre-tax profit before one-off items, showing that converting that backlog into steady earnings growth is not happening smoothly. At close to 150 times earnings, the stock is priced for a much smoother execution path than the last quarter actually delivered, leaving little room for further disappointment.
